text: Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
And He found you lost and guided you.
So remember Me; I will remember you.
Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.
And whoever puts their trust in Allah, then He will suffice him.
Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
And We have certainly made the Quran easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
My mercy encompasses all things.
And speak to people good words.
Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out.
And We send down of the Quran that which is healing and mercy for the believers.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
He is with you wherever you are.
Call upon Me; I will respond to you.
And do good; indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.
Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good.
And seek help through patience and prayer.
Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing.
And your Lord says, 'Call upon Me; I will respond to you.'
And We have certainly created man and We know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
Be patient, for indeed, the promise of Allah is truth.
And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.
Allah is the ally of those who believe. He brings them out from darknesses into the light.
And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate.
Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account.
And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds.
Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.
And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided.
Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.
So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.
The life of this world is only the enjoyment of deception.
And whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while being a believer - those will enter Paradise.
Indeed, mankind is in loss, except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds.
And when My servants ask you concerning Me - indeed I am near.
And say, 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge.'
Indeed, the best provision is righteousness.
And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for himself.
If you are grateful, I will surely increase you in favor.
And the Hereafter is better for you than the first life.
So verily, with the hardship, there is relief.
Say, 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.'
And Allah is the best of providers.
And do not lose hope in the mercy of Allah.
Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves.
And it may be that you dislike a thing which is good for you.
Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.
And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice.
And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth.
The best among you are those who have the best manners and character.
The strong person is not the one who can wrestle someone else down. The strong person is the one who can control himself when he is angry.
None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
The most beloved of deeds to Allah are those that are most consistent, even if they are small.
Make things easy and do not make them difficult. Give good news and do not repel people.
A good word is charity.
Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.
The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
Smiling in the face of your brother is an act of charity.
Take advantage of five before five: your youth before your old age, your health before your illness, your riches before your poverty, your free time before your work, and your life before your death.
Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler.
The believer is not stung twice from the same hole.
Whoever does not thank people has not thanked Allah.
The best supplication is on the Day of Arafah.
Allah does not look at your appearances or wealth, but rather He looks at your hearts and actions.
Modesty is part of faith.
The best wealth is a tongue that remembers Allah, a grateful heart, and a believing wife who helps in his faith.
Cleanliness is half of faith.
Whoever treads a path seeking knowledge, Allah will make easy for him the path to Paradise.
The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the people are safe.
Actions are judged by intentions.
The two feet of the son of Adam will not move on the Day of Judgment until he is asked about his life and how he spent it.
Richness is not having many possessions, but richness is being content with oneself.
Whoever is kind, Allah will be kind to him. Be kind to those on earth, and the One in heaven will be kind to you.
Give charity without delay, for it stands in the way of calamity.
The most perfect of believers in faith are those with the best character.
When Allah loves a servant, He tests him.
Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
Paradise lies under the feet of mothers.
The best of houses is a house in which an orphan is well-treated.
Verily, supplication is worship.
Whoever is not grateful for small things will not be grateful for large things.
The best of charity is that given by one who has little.
Every act of kindness is charity.
Allah loves that when you do something, you do it with excellence.
The supplication of a fasting person is not rejected.
Whoever fasts Ramadan with faith and seeking reward, his past sins will be forgiven.
Part of the excellence of a person's Islam is leaving that which does not concern him.
The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charity.
Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most false of speech.
Tie your camel and trust in Allah.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest.
The best of people are those most beneficial to others.
Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.
There is no disease that Allah has created except that He also has created its treatment.
The seeking of knowledge is obligatory for every Muslim.
Speak the truth even if it is bitter.
He who does not show mercy, will not be shown mercy.
Remember death often, for it is the destroyer of pleasures.
Faith has over seventy branches, the most excellent of which is the declaration that there is no god but Allah.
He is not one of us who does not have mercy on our young and respect our elders.
Envy is permitted only in two cases: A man whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it righteously, and a man whom Allah has given wisdom and he acts according to it and teaches it to others.
If you put your trust completely in Allah, He would provide for you as He provides for the birds.
The best remembrance is 'There is no god but Allah' and the best supplication is 'All praise is due to Allah.'
Nothing is heavier on the believer's Scale on the Day of Judgment than good character.
I was sent only to perfect good character.
